name: Aten Ra
inspiration: Aten, Ra/Re, Ma’at, Khepri, Set/Sutekh, Isis/Iset, Maahes, Amun/Amunet, pharaonic regalia, Nile/Red Land cosmology, and Egyptian temple/afterlife symbolism — treated as human echoes of the older Aten Ra Realm.
philosophy: Ma’at is not morality to Aten Ra; it is physics. Solar authority, measured truth, and sacred kingship keep Isfet from unmaking reality.
culture: An extradimensional solar civilization whose crowns, pylons, collars, sun-discs, scarabs, throne-magic, river rites, lion guardians, and desert-storm wardens later appeared in human Egyptian myth as imperfect memories of the source Realm.
visualIdentity: Solar-disc crowns with hand-like rays, pharaonic collars and pectorals, linen-and-gold regalia, faience blue-green inlays, lapis/obsidian shadows, scarab renewal marks, falcon/jackal/lion/cobra masks, lotus/papyrus river motifs, pylon harnesses, was-sceptre weapon geometry, Ma’at balance lines, Nile-black and desert-red duality.
combatPhilosophy: Hold the field through Ma’at: solar command zones, judgment beams, renewal engines, river sustain, desert disruption, lion interception, hidden-name execution, and anti-chaos rites against Isfet.
factionPassive: Solar Law: coordinated deities gain defensive clarity after holding objectives.
mixingRule: Current canon keeps faction identity separated unless a campaign rule explicitly permits a mixed chosen deity.
sourceCultureRule: source culture humans later copied as Egyptian solar myth

name: Asgardian

philosophy: A vow is not language to Asgardians; it is weather, weapon, bloodline, and law. Oath held becomes power. Oath broken becomes storm judgment.
culture: A realm-born oath civilization whose halls, runes, ravens, world-root bridges, funerary feasts, shield walls, Valkyrie weatherfields, and storm kings later entered human Norse myth as distorted saga memory.
visualIdentity: storm-iron mail, oath-ring collars, raven and wolf omen shapes, world-root veins, Valkyrie wing-weather, thunder scars, frost-giant mass, shield-wall geometry, ash wood, funeral flame, runes burned as physical wounds not UI glow.
combatPhilosophy: Endure through oath, counter through storm, bind allies through shield-wall law, harvest fallen courage, and weaponize Ragnarok pressure before the Hollow can make doom meaningless.
factionPassive: Oathbound: surviving damage strengthens the next committed strike.
mixingRule: Current canon keeps faction identity separated unless a campaign rule explicitly permits a mixed chosen deity.
sourceCultureRule: source culture humans later copied as Norse myth

philosophy: Excellence is sacred only when witnessed. Olympian power is trial, beauty, rivalry, law, and victory turned into divine physics.

visualIdentity: living marble-light bodies, bronze cuirasses, laurel circuits, aegis scales, thunder tribunal halos, oracle smoke, amphitheater armor curves, hoplite shield geometry, winged victory accents, gold-blue skyfire, carved but non-readable relief bands.
